task_description: Tell me how many files can be executed directly no matter where my work dir is.

args.script:
IFS=: read -ra DIRS <<< "$PATH"
declare -A seen
for d in "${DIRS[@]}"; do
  if [ -d "$d" ]; then
    while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
      rp=$(realpath "$f")
      if [ -x "$f" ] && [ -f "$f" ]; then
        seen["$rp"]=1
      fi
    done < <(find "$d" -maxdepth 1 -type f -executable -print0 2>/dev/null)
  fi
done
echo ${#seen[@]}
